An overview of training days at the skyport
The desk wrote this for people travelling soon
Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance for smooth travel

This article outlines the routine work that keeps companion animal travel orderly at Aurelia Skyways. Our team aims to make each handoff calm, clear, and respectful for travelers and animals alike.

Before departure, the desk reviews travel details, carrier readiness, and the animal's basic comfort needs. We ask travelers to keep documents easy to reach and to ensure the carrier is secure, clean, and suitable for the journey. When information is complete, the process is usually straightforward and less stressful for everyone involved.

At the skyport, the ground team moves carriers carefully between services and keeps them upright, closed, and protected from unnecessary handling. If a traveler needs guidance, the desk provides concise steps in plain language and confirms what the next service point will require. This helps reduce delays and supports a calmer flow through the terminal.

During handover, we encourage travelers to remain close to their animal and to follow staff direction closely. If a pet appears unsettled, the team will respond with patience and practical support. Small details, such as a familiar blanket or a familiar tone of voice, can make the experience easier for the animal.

After check-in, the desk continues to monitor the booking notes so that any change in handling is shared promptly with the relevant team. If a special requirement has been arranged, it is best to mention it again when speaking with staff so that the record and the live process remain aligned.

For further help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways, and we will guide you with care.
